disclaimer: District-level Soil Suitability Classification (1S to 5) derived from Department of Agriculture Malaysia GeoTanih reference maps. Always confirm with field observation (soil texture and drainage).

zones.limitation_summary_en: Class 2d: Good agricultural land with minor drainage limitation in low-lying pockets.
zones.limitation_summary_ms: Kelas 2d: Tanah pertanian baik dengan had saliran kecil di kawasan rendah.

zones.limitation_summary_en: Class 2d: Heavy marine/alluvial clay suited to paddy; requires raised beds and drainage ditches for upland vegetables.
zones.limitation_summary_ms: Kelas 2d: Tanah liat aluvium sesuai untuk padi; memerlukan batas tinggi dan parit saliran untuk sayur tanah darat.

zones.limitation_summary_en: Class 3t: Undulating inland terrain; drains fast and needs organic mulch to retain moisture.
zones.limitation_summary_ms: Kelas 3t: Tanah pedalaman beralun; cepat kering dan memerlukan sungkupan organik untuk mengekalkan kelembapan.

default_zone.limitation_summary_en: Estimated mineral soil profile (map-based). Confirm soil texture and drainage on your plot.
default_zone.limitation_summary_ms: Anggaran profil tanah mineral (berasaskan peta). Sahkan tekstur tanah dan saliran di kebun anda.
